resources.string:
You have reached the NEMESIS Installation Interface.

Confirm your intention of installing NEMESIS on this head unit, risk of rendering this device inoperable always exists and you take full responsibility for it.

If you decide not to proceed, press Decline to begin the cleanup process of the installer.

Learn more about NEMESIS by scanning the QR code.
NEMESIS 1.17 and later are not compatible with your HMG-API version, update it or uninstall to continue installation.

NEMESIS 1.17 and later are not compatible with your HMG-API version. Update HMG-API to 1.1.0-rc.10 or later to continue installation. Do not uninstall HMG-API before updating it: with NEMESIS 1.17 installed, uninstalling this HMG-API version will render the HU inoperable.
NEMESIS 1.17 and later utilize a critical system component (app_process binary) for additional features, which has been modified, restore it to factory state to continue installation.
Something went wrong triggering the install: %s\n\nCheck the USB stick is still inserted and press Proceed or Decline again.
